answers.rationale: The requirement describes a service substation integrating HV-to-MV transformers and MV buses. The ANORD-PSS product, a packaged substation, fits this description as it includes transformers and MV switchgear, and can be customized to meet the specific integration needs.

The requirement specifies 15 kV-class metal-clad switchgear with arc-rated construction (Type 2B). The CROWN-ARMV product matches this description as it is arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear built to IEEE C37.20.7 Type 2B standards.
The requirement involves MV control power with a 110 VDC battery-backed system. The EP2-AUX product, an auxiliary power system, is suitable for providing DC control power for MV systems.
The requirement specifies relays with communication and event recording capabilities. The EP2-RPP product, which includes protective relays and SCADA interfaces, meets this need.
The requirement involves backup generation, which is not covered by the listed products in the catalog. This is likely a responsibility for the bid manager to address.
The requirement involves interconnection studies and protection-coordination data, which are services rather than product requirements. This is likely a responsibility for the bid manager to address.
The requirement specifies power blocks converting MV AC to 800 VDC, which does not match any product in the catalog. This may require a custom solution or further clarification from the customer.

The requirement specifies short-circuit withstand and grounding details, which are design parameters rather than specific product requirements. This is likely a responsibility for the bid manager to address.
